mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1% over the past 3 months signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS < 1% but other macro conditions are unfavorable (e.g., high CPIAUCSL).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden 0.5 percentage point increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 2.5% triggers investor concerns about inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% in the trigger period, or the inflation spike is transitory (CPIAUCSL reverts below 2.5% within 30 days).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% and sustained growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) above 5% in the prior quarter signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND GDPC1 increases by 5% in the prior quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and GDPC1 growth occurs, despite other favorable conditions.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 4% quarterly), rising quarterly GDP growth predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate further gains.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when GDPC1 growth > 4% and the regime is active, compared to baseline periods.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of falling unemployment (UNRATE below 5%) and rising federal funds rates above 1% indicates tightening labor markets and restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE < 5% and FEDFUNDS > 1% in the trigger period, or the policy shift is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the INDPRO index below 95 triggers concerns about supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings growth.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses below 95 in the next month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 95, or the supply shock is temporary (INDPRO reverts above 95 within 30 days).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 1% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1% in the next week
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 1%, or the rate hike is reversed within 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (PAYEMS falling below 4.5%) coupled with rising demand in millions of dollars (RSAFS > 1.2M) indicates strengthening labor markets and robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 4.5% AND RSAFS > 1.2M in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS < 4.5% and RSAFS > 1.2M, despite other favorable indicators.
